# American Pizza Da Nang

> Authentic American tavern-style pizza in Da Nang, Vietnam. Three-day fermented dough, house-blended imported mozzarella, generous toppings, fired at 330°C. Run by Mike from California and his Vietnamese wife.

## Essentials

- Address: 72/9 Nguyễn Văn Thoại, Ngũ Hành Sơn, Da Nang, Vietnam (a few minutes from My Khe Beach)
- Phone: +84 90 575 99 86
- Hours: daily 2:00pm to 11:00pm
- Sizes: Medium 10 inch / 25 cm (feeds two), Large 14 inch / 35 cm (feeds four)
- How to order: dine in, takeaway, GrabFood delivery, or an order request on the website confirmed by phone
- Reservations: request on the website or by phone; reserved dine-in tables get 10% off
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/p/American-Pizza-61578195429921/
- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@pizzamy.vn

## Menu

- Cheese: house-blended imported mozzarella
- Pepperoni: the most popular pie, loaded edge to edge
- Meat Lover: pepperoni, ham and sausage
- Hawaiian: ham and pineapple
- Canadian: ham, mushrooms and bell peppers
- Vegetarian: mushrooms, onions, bell peppers, black olives and pineapple
- Half and Half: any two pies on one 14 inch crust
- Build your own from the cheese pizza with extra toppings
